card.name: Words before survival or predator-defense goals
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, in, their, if and times, in nature-writing about animals avoiding predators or surviving danger. The next words usually describe fooling, deterring or surviving threats.

modes.label: Animal defense
modes.description: Linking word right before a verb of fooling or deterring predators by mimicry or camouflage.
modes.example: the vivid colouration of poison frogs<< to>> fool would-be predators.

modes.label: Survival under threat
modes.description: Linking word before staying alive or surviving in danger, persecution or stress.
modes.example: they metastasize because they have a greater<< chance>> of surviving," he says.

modes.label: Adaptation to habitat
modes.description: Word before a description of how traits help an animal in its habitat.
modes.example: Sharp toenails and agility help them<< in>> their arboreal existence.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about safety and shelter (safest, safer, tent) and away from competition words.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before a phrase about an animal protecting itself or surviving danger.
